title: Matt LaFleur saw "protection busts that should not and cannot happen" on Vikings film

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Matt LaFleur saw "protection busts that should not and cannot happen" on Vikings film
sources.description: Packers quarterback Jordan Love was pressured relentlessly by the Vikings' defense in Sunday's 39-22 loss, and Matt LaFleur said after watching the film that the pass protection needed to be a lot better.
